claimLedger.claim: Most reliable from first day of missed period (or ≥21 days after unprotected sex if timing unknown); positive almost certainly correct; negative less reliable if early/incorrect use; retest and see GP if still no period.

claimLedger.limitations: UK access to free tests; brand sensitivity varies.
